text.ms:
1. Bagi maksud penyelenggaraan, pembaikan, peningkatan, pembersihan dan

pemugaran bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama.

2. Bagi maksud pemacakan, pemasangan, penyelenggaraan, pengubahan atau

pengalihan mana-mana struktur, kerja, peralatan atau apa-apa benda di dalam,

pada, di bawah atau di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama.

3. Mana-mana kenderaan Kerajaan yang mempunyai lambang rasmi Jabatan

Perlindungan Hidupan Liar dan Taman Negara (PERHILITAN) Semenanjung

Malaysia yang dilekatkan pada badan kenderaan itu.

4. Bagi maksud perkhidmatan kecemasan dan penguatkuasaan oleh agensi Kerajaan

dan pihak berkuasa tempatan.".

Dibuat 22 Jun 2026

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.10; PN(PU2)460/JLD.142]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 3) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to

in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use

of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 3) (Amendment) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 23 June 2026.

New paragraph 3

2. The Road Transport (Prohibition of Use of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 3)

Order 2025 [P.U. (A) 55/2025], which is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order,

is amended by inserting after paragraph 2 the following paragraph:

"Exemption

3. Exemption from such prohibition shall be given for the purposes and

in circumstances specified in the Third Schedule.".

New Third Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by inserting after the Second Schedule

the following schedule:

"THIRD SCHEDULE

EXEMPTION

1. For the purposes of maintenance, repair, improvement, cleaning and clearance of

the part of road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

2. For the purposes of erection, installation, maintenance, alteration or removal of

any structure, works, apparatus or any thing in, on, under or over the part of the

road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

3. Any Government vehicle bearing the official emblem of the Department of

Wildlife and National Parks (PERHILITAN) Peninsular Malaysia affixed on the

vehicle's body.

4. For the purposes of emergency services and enforcement by the Government

agencies and local authorities.".

Made 22 June 2026

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.11; PN(PU2)460/JLD.142]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Works
